commands.review_summary:
The branch changes bounded web-shared and HTTP error body decoding so truncated byte prefixes use streaming UTF-8 decode, and adds regression tests.

PR surface: Source +2, Tests +53. Total +55 across 4 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection and the TextDecoder probe: current bounded response readers can decode an incomplete UTF-8 byte prefix into U+FFFD. I did not run a full live provider or web_fetch scenario.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The PR needs contributor-supplied real behavior proof plus a code update for sibling snippet readers; ClawSweeper should not open a repair job while the external-proof gate is still unmet.

target.title: fix(infra): drop replacement characters when response snippets truncate UTF-8
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users could see replacement characters in bounded web/provider error snippets when a response body was truncated in the middle of a multi-byte UTF-8 character.

## Why This Change Was Made

The bounded response readers now use streaming decode only for truncated byte prefixes, so incomplete trailing UTF-8 sequences are omitted instead of rendered as U+FFFD. The change keeps the normal full-response decode path flushing normally, and uses a fresh UTF-8 fallback decoder so unsupported charset fallback cannot retain streaming state between responses.

## User Impact

Provider error details and web_fetch snippets remain clean and readable when OpenClaw caps large response bodies at a byte boundary.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: bounded response text helpers drop partial UTF-8 characters when stream reads stop at maxBytes, while preserving clean fallback charset decoding between responses.
- Current-head proof at 5d9ef2ab883ab8e51b587fa6b929347c91d15176: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/http-error-body.test.ts src/agents/tools/web-shared.test.ts` passed 2 Vitest shards / 31 tests.
- PR diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed.
- Review proof: `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode branch --base upstream/main` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Duplicate search: no open or closed OpenClaw PRs found for the bounded response UTF-8 truncation / replacement-character issue.
